name: ScrollWordSwap
description: A big pinned headline inside its own smooth-scroll viewport whose key word swaps once per scroll section with a masked slide, blur or flip, while the word color, background wash and segmented progress bar shift to each word's tint.
a11yNotes: The viewport is a focusable role="region" whose aria-label carries the full sentence with every word, so keyboard users can Tab to it and scroll with arrow/Page keys/Space (native, unsmoothed) with a 2px :focus-visible outline. The heading exposes the complete text (prefix, all words, suffix) through a visually hidden span while the animated word stack is aria-hidden, so screen readers are not spammed while scrolling. Wheel input is smoothed only while the viewport can still move; at the edges wheel events are released to the page, and touch and scrollbar dragging stay native. Background washes and progress segments are decorative. Under prefers-reduced-motion the wheel is not intercepted and words switch instantly without slide, blur, flip or color transitions.

propsApi.name: words
propsApi.description: Words swapped in, one per equal scroll section.

propsApi.name: colors
propsApi.description: Tint per word (cycled) used for the word color, background wash and progress fill.

propsApi.name: effect
propsApi.description: Transition used when the word swaps; all are clipped by the word's mask slot.

propsApi.name: duration
propsApi.description: Swap transition duration in ms (the background wash crossfades slightly slower).

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the component's own scroll viewport in px (width is always 100%).

propsApi.name: borderRadius
propsApi.description: Corner radius of the viewport in px.

propsApi.name: lerp
propsApi.description: Interpolation factor per 60fps frame for wheel smoothing (0.05 floaty, 0.3 snappy).

propsApi.name: wheelMultiplier
propsApi.description: Multiplier applied to wheel and trackpad deltas.

propsApi.name: smooth
propsApi.description: Enable smooth wheel scrolling; false (or prefers-reduced-motion) uses native scrolling.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
